record.question: While giving NG tube feeding, which of the following nursing actions prevents complication?
options: Plug the air vent during feeding
record.explanation: Answer C: Provide high fowlers position. Elevating the head of bed to a high-Fowler position during tube feeding reduces aspiration risk. Source/context note: Confirm tube placement and follow local enteral-feeding policy; position alone does not prevent all aspiration. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK568801/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
